translationRepairs: He lost his father early and grew up with his mother among the Türks. Later General An Bo came, and Yan Yan, the elder brother of An Bo, took his mother as wife.
He lost his father early and grew up with his mother among the Türks. Later Yanyan, elder brother of General An Bozhi, took his mother as wife.
安波至 is one name (An Bozhi); 至 is not the verb 'came'.
In the twelfth year the emperor sent the eunuch Fu Yuolin to spy on him; Yuolin took Lushan's bribes and returned praising his loyalty.
In the twelfth year the emperor sent the eunuch Fu Qiulin to spy on him; Yuolin took Lushan's bribes and returned praising his loyalty.
As stud commissioner he secretly culled the best tribute horses and seized the Loufan stud and Zhang Wenyian's pastures.
As stud commissioner he secretly culled the best tribute horses and seized the Loufan stud and Zhang Wenyan's pastures.

In the first month of the fifteenth year they declared Yan and the era Shengwu, with Daxi Xun and others as chancellors. In the fifth month Lu Kui of Nanyang led a hundred thousand men from Jing, Xiang, Qianzhong, and Lingnan against Wu Lingxun at the Fen River north of Yexian; the imperial force was wiped out.

In the first month of the fifteenth year they declared Yan and the era Shengwu, with Daxi Xun and others as chancellors. In the fifth month Lu Jiong of Nanyang led a hundred thousand men from Jing, Xiang, Qianzhong, and Lingnan against Wu Lingxun at the Fen River north of Yexian; the imperial force was wiped out.
They posted Zhang Tongru as Luoyang intendant, Tian Qianzhen as Jingzhao governor, and An Shouzhong in the imperial park.
They posted Zhang Tongru as Western Capital intendant, Tian Qianzhen as Jingzhao governor, and An Shouzhong in the imperial park.
西京留守 is the Western Capital intendant, not Luoyang.
Zhuang took the titles rebel Censor-in-Chief and Prince of Fufeng and ran the state himself.
Zhuang took the titles rebel Censor-in-Chief and Prince of Fengyi and ran the state himself.
馮翊郡王 is Prince of Fengyi Commandery.

Only Neng Yuanhao of Qing and Qi surrendered with his force. In Qianyuan 1 Wang Min of Dezhou, Yuwen Kuan of Beizhou, and others defected; but when Hebei garrisons held out for months, Cai Xide and An Taiqing stormed them back, carried off the defenders, and ate their flesh.

Only Neng Yuanhao of Qing and Qi surrendered with his force. In Qianyuan 1 Wang Jian of Dezhou, Yuwen Kuan of Beizhou, and others defected; but when Hebei garrisons held out for months, Cai Xide and An Taiqing stormed them back, carried off the defenders, and ate their flesh.
When Yan Gaoqing killed Li Qintou at Tumen and rumors spread that Prince Wan and Ge Shuhan led two hundred thousand through Hebei, seventeen districts submitted.
When Yan Gaoqing killed Li Qincou at Tumen and rumors spread that Prince Wan and Ge Shuhan led two hundred thousand through Hebei, seventeen districts submitted.
Yan Zhenqing smashed Yuan Zhiben at Tangyi; Helan Jinming retook Xindu twice; Li Guangbi and Guo Ziyi retook Changshan and Zhao—Hebei was severed again and again.
Yan Zhenqing smashed Yuan Zhifeng at Tangyi; Helan Jinming retook Xindu twice; Li Guangbi and Guo Ziyi retook Changshan and Zhao—Hebei was severed again and again.
小字 is a childhood name, not a courtesy name.
Just then Tong Pass fell; Emperor Suzong gathered forces at Shuofang and sent the eunuch Xing Yan'en to recall the Shuofang and Hedong armies.
Just then Tong Pass fell; Emperor Suzong gathered forces at Shuofang and sent the eunuch Xing Ting'en to recall the Shuofang and Hedong armies.
Cheng'en's mother and wife were already in rebel hands; Siming captured his nephew Congze and sent him to negotiate; Cheng'en surrendered, and Siming clasped his arm and drank with him.
Cheng'en's mother and wife were already in rebel hands; Siming captured his son Congze and sent him to negotiate; Cheng'en surrendered, and Siming clasped his arm and drank with him.
He then sent Kang Moyabo against Pingyuan.
He then sent Kang Moyebo against Pingyuan.
Grand Marshal, why not petition with all the generals to execute Li Guangbi and answer to the people of Hebei?
Your Excellency, why not petition with all the generals to execute Li Guangbi and answer to the people of Hebei?
大夫 addresses Siming as Censor-in-chief, not 太尉.
At Weizhou Siming slaughtered thirty thousand; blood pooled for days—it was the first day of Qianyuan year two.
At Weizhou, Siming slaughtered thirty thousand; blood pooled for days—it was the first day of Qianyuan year two.
Yu Chao'en believed it and told Li Guangbi, Pugu Huai'en, Wei Buyu, and the other commissioners: "March at once against the remnant rebels."
Yu Chao'en believed it and told Li Guangbi, Pugu Huai'en, Wei Boyu, and the other commissioners: "March at once against the remnant rebels."
Pugu Huai'en and the Uyghur leader Zuo Sha led the vanguard; Yu Chao'en and Guo Yingyi brought up the rear, entering through Mianchi.
Pugu Huai'en and the Uyghur Left Shad led the vanguard; Yu Chao'en and Guo Yingyi brought up the rear, entering through Mianchi.
左殺 is a Uyghur title, not a personal name.
